Subject: Samantha Cho — virtual full-loop scheduling & panel sequence

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood. We'd like to schedule a virtual full interview loop next week (4 interviews + 30m debrief). Below are some proposed windows — please let me know which of these work for you and whether you're open to an early start (8:30am PT) if needed to align across timezones:

- Tue 11/28: 9:30am–1:00pm PT (preferred)
- Wed 11/29: 1:00pm–4:00pm PT
- Thu 11/30: 10:00am–2:00pm PT (backup)

Proposed panel sequence (we can rearrange based on interviewer availability):
1) Systems design (Laura Bennett) — 50m
2) Backend/domain deep-dive (Marissa Cole) — 50m
3) Cross-functional/product sense (Naomi Feldman) — 40m
4) Culture/leadership (Kimberly Park) — 30m
+ 30m candidate + panel debrief (internal)

I've attached a short briefing doc and the copy of your resume we have on file. If you have any constraints or need accommodations, tell me and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: virtual-onsite-brief.pdf (interview flow, tech checks), SamanthaCho_Resume.pdf

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks — Tue 11/28 at the 9:30am start works best for me. I'm fine with the panel order as listed. A couple of quick questions:

- Are the interviews on Google Meet? Any special link for the candidate?
- Will the debrief be immediately after the last interview or scheduled separately?

Also attaching an updated resume with a one-line clarification on my last project (small change).

Best,
Samantha

Thanks, Samantha — welcome. Kimberly, per our rotation I'm available Tue 11/28 at 9:30am PT for the systems design slot. - We're interested in how Samantha reasons about service boundaries and state management under high-throughput constraints.
